title: Implement a fail-closed PowerShell read-only reviewer command checker
outcome: Windows reviewer sessions currently deny PowerShell tool calls wholesale because routing PowerShell syntax through the Bash read-only parser enabled security bypasses and arbitrary execution from the reviewed tree. Design and implement a dedicated PowerShell parser/checker that only approves an explicit read-only command subset, preserves fail-closed behavior for substitutions, redirection, script invocation, and path execution, and add Windows-focused allow/deny regressions before enabling the PowerShell tool.
